title: W25a Mac references: the command bar's history rows
about: Kite for Mac from origin/main (W25a changes no Mac code). One state: Ctrl+T's bar over windows/helix/states/command-bar-history.json (sidebar.json with the engine's suggestions off, so no network rows), with windows/helix/states/command-bar-history.history.json as the profile's history.json, and "recipe" typed. The Windows capture is Kite.exe --capture --window-size 1280,820 --capture-scale 2 --command-bar recipe on the same two files. Needs two things the capture script doesn't take yet: a history file copied into the profile as history.json ("history", shaped like "session"), and typed text (input "text"; the bar is opened with a click on New Tab, not a key).

states.name: command-bar-history
states.holds: Ctrl+T's bar with "recipe" typed: the DuckDuckGo search highlighted, then three pages from history, Pasta Carbonara Recipe — recipes.example/pasta-carbonara, recipes.example (no subtitle: it has no title), Recipe Index: Weeknight Dinners — blog.example/2026/01/recipe-index; no tab rows (no open tab matches)
